# Journal of Economics and Finance

## Identity
- **Abbreviation:** J Econ Finan
- **Publisher:** Springer (Springer US, New York); official journal of the Academy of Economics and Finance
- **ISSN:** 1055-0925 (SCImago listing; online ISSN UNVERIFIED)
- **Homepage:** https://link.springer.com/journal/12197
- **Author guidelines:** https://link.springer.com/journal/12197/submission-guidelines

## Scope
Per the Springer aims-and-scope page: theoretical and empirical research papers in economics and finance, with the main emphasis on empirical work using recent econometric advances and on the policy relevance of the findings. Finance sub-topics are not itemised (UNVERIFIED).

## Scope Keywords
empirical finance, econometrics, financial markets, economics, policy relevance

## Article Types Accepted
- Original research paper — other types UNVERIFIED

## Classification
- **Tier:** Q3 — SCImago SJR 2025 = 0.413; Finance Q3; Economics and Econometrics Q3 (Q2 in 2024) (scimagojr.com source id 12100157208)
- **Open Access:** Hybrid (Springer subscription with optional Open Choice); no mandatory APC; OA price UNVERIFIED
- **Field:** Economics / Finance

## Special Notes
Review speed (Springer journal page, 2025 metrics): submission to first decision (median) 10 days; Springer medians include desk decisions. AI policy (Springer Nature): LLMs cannot be authors; LLM use must be documented in the Methods section (or an equivalent section); AI-assisted copy editing need not be declared.

## Acceptance Signals
- **Selectivity band:** accessible-to-selective (acceptance rate UNVERIFIED)
- **Study-type tolerance:** empirical econometric work emphasised
- **Cascade / transfer:** Springer Nature Transfer Desk (publisher-level service; per-title availability UNVERIFIED); sister titles Annals of Finance, Review of Quantitative Finance and Accounting, Computational Economics
